notes.title: Streaming controls and screen mode on their way!
notes.content:
Hi Everybody!

Thank you so much for your fantastic feedback so far. We are honored to see our game being streamed on Twitch and Youtube.

This is what we are working on right now to improve the game:

Streaming controls: (to be released in portions within 1-3 weeks)
[list]
[*] Hide Joincode - When you are streaming and don’t want everybody to join.
[*] Kick players - If a player losses connection, it can be nice to kick them and move on.
[*] Disable pause button - Only allow pausing from the keyboard.
[*] Screen mode settings - Change between windowed and full screen.
[/list]

We have received many more suggestions for new features, we have a busy spring in front of us! 
Stay tuned for more.
